name: Barbell Rack Pull
steps: Set a barbell on rack supports just below knee height, stand with feet hip-width apart, hinge at your hips, and grip just outside your thighs.
Pull your chest slightly up, engage your lats to remove slack, and brace your core with a flat back.
Drive powerfully through your feet to extend your hips and knees until you stand tall with the bar against your thighs.
Hinge back at your hips and soften your knees to return the bar smoothly to the supports.
tips: Finish tall by squeezing your glutes without leaning backward at lockout.
Set the bar back down cleanly on the supports without bouncing into the next repetition.
